docket_entries.description: REMARK: RETURNED MAIL: ORDER OF DISMISSAL OF ENTIRE ACTION MAILED TO PLAINTIFF ON 7/5/19. PER U.S. POSTAL SERVICE, "RETURN TO SENDER - ATTEMPTED - NOT KNOWN - UNABLE TO FORWARD."
